text: The variational principle relates topological and metric entropy by:
choices: h_top(f) = inf over mu of h_mu(f)
h_top(f) = sup over mu of h_mu(f)
explanation: h_top is the supremum of KS entropies over all invariant measures; the maximizer is the measure of maximal entropy. It is a supremum, not an infimum, and generally exceeds a given h_mu.
